description: The Information and Analysis Centre for positioning, navigation and timing publishes the official monitoring pages of the Russian GLONASS satellite navigation system. The site read on 2026-09-28 offers, in English, Russian, Chinese, German and Spanish, pages on constellation status, the ground control segment, the almanac and ephemerides, current satellite positions, system availability including instant availability, ionosphere conditions, user performance with hourly and daily monitoring, technical characteristics and system documents. Coverage is global. Access is free on the web; a page of rules for using the information is linked but was not read. Caveats: the satellite map and several tables render by script, so the cloud session read only the menus and did not check formats or archive depth. It supports resilience and cascading failure studies of positioning-dependent infrastructure, such as timing outages when satellites are unhealthy or the ionosphere is disturbed. Related record: the DLR GNSS performance monitoring covers GLONASS alongside other constellations.
